# Flipbook

> Play a sprite sheet in Resolume

A page of stills, cut into a grid and played as an animation, as an FFGL source and a
matching effect for Resolume and an OpenFX plugin for Resolve. Up to sixty-four copies
with a stagger, so one animation travels through the field instead of sixty-four of them
doing the same thing at once.

This page, https://flipbook.stoatworks-labs.com/: The Flipbook FFGL plugin's playback running live in WebGL2. Drop your own sprite sheet on it, set the grid, and watch it play — copies, stagger, keying and all.
